One of the best all-finnish [[4on4]] teams in the 21th century. Koff has a rich and long history with many players coming and going, but the team consisting {{Player|eh|flag=fi}}, {{Player|jukka|flag=fi}}, {{Player|Gamer |flag=fi}} and {{Player|Scenic|flag=fi}} is probably the most famous and most successful.
